How it works

One marketplace, three controlled workflows.

Businesses

Register, get approved, subscribe, upload products, and track advertising history.

Earners

Choose a configurable tier, download approved ads, submit screenshots, and track earnings.

Referrals

Earn qualifying commissions only after referred users complete required actions.

Withdrawals

Request eligible balances for Tuesday or Saturday review through approved M-Pesa settings.

FAQ

Clear answers before users commit.

Are earnings guaranteed?

No. Earnings depend on approved advertising activity and verifiable views.

Can earners contact merchants?

No. Merchant contact details stay private and the platform acts as the intermediary.

When do ads expire?

Each advertisement remains active for 24 hours after approval or upload activation.

When are withdrawals processed?

Withdrawals are scheduled for Tuesday and Saturday, subject to admin approval and provider availability.
